```plaintext
(Currently Amended) Claim 281: A tool comprising: a medial section; a first adhesive layer located on a first side of the medial section; a second adhesive layer located on a second side of the medial section opposite the first adhesive layer; and an additional adhesive layer located between and aligned with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer, the additional adhesive layer having a substantially uniform thickness and being configured to bond the first adhesive layer to the second adhesive layer.

(Original) Claim 282: The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section comprises a metal.

(Original) Claim 283: The tool of claim 282, wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure.

(Original) Claim 284: The tool of claim 283, wherein the medial section is a composite material.

(Original) Claim 285: The tool of claim 281, further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer.

(Original) Claim 286: The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section.

(Original) Claim 287: The tool of claim 286, wherein the weld ring is continuous.

(Original) Claim 288: The tool of claim 287, wherein the tool has a circular shape and includes a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments.
```
